headline: Sets the order of officials who would step in to run the Department of Defense if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This executive order sets an order of succession for the Department of Defense. It lists which officials would act as Secretary of Defense, in order, if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or are otherwise unable to do the job. Orders like this usually replace an earlier list. No summary was provided, so the specific officials and their order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their place in line to temporarily lead the department may be set or changed by this order.
